name: The goats
alt: A white goat with curved horns faces the camera in a grassy enclosure.
introduction: A close-up introduction to some of the faces that make Critter Creek memorable.
story:
The photographs tell a little of the story: time outdoors, a patch of green grass, and plenty to notice around the ranch.

Get to know the goats as part of a visit arranged with our team. Ask questions about their care, and discover what goes into looking after the animals who call Critter Creek home.
care: Animal care happens every day. Your support helps the ranch continue caring for the animals on site.
